children: Idaho Copper Corp reported a third-quarter 2026 net loss as the company remains in the exploration stage and recorded no revenue for the period. Increased operating, payroll and professional expenses tied to ramped-up operations, fundraising and listing activities drove a wider loss versus the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue: $0 for 3Q 2026 (Company reports no revenues historically).
Net income: Net loss of $(2.21M) for the three months ended July 31, 2026, versus net loss of $(0.78M) in the year‑ago quarter.
Diluted EPS: $(0.14) for the three months ended July 31, 2026, versus $(0.06) in the year‑ago quarter.
Material Project Focus: The CuMo Project is the company’s sole material mining operation, covering roughly 2,640 acres in Boise County, Idaho.
Exploration Stage: Idaho Copper remains in exploration and has not established proven economically recoverable mineral reserves for its mineral rights.
Operational Ramp-Up: The company increased operational, fundraising and listing activities in 2026, leading to higher operations, payroll and professional expenses during the quarter.
Listing & Capital Markets Milestone: Idaho Copper completed its NYSE American listing and an underwritten offering, converting private notes into equity and issuing warrants.
